site.name: weaveapi
site.summary: weaveapi-clone Fictional payments API platform "WeaveAPI" developer docs (Stripe-style). Pages (shared docs three-column layout: left nav / center body / right try-it or anchors) | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Docs home: Quickstart, Authentication, Idempotency, Pagination, Errors sections + Popular guides 4 cards | | `quickstart.html` | Install + first-charge two-step example | | `charges.html` | Charges API: Charge object 18-field table + 5 endpoint sections (POST create / GET single / capture / refund / list), each section with parameter table + multi-lang code block + JSON response example; right-column try-it panel syncs with the current endpoint as you scroll, fill params + Send returns a mock response (`currency=usd/eur/gbp/jpy` returns a charge object, anything else returns `currency_not_supported`) |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the WeaveAPI developer documentation, focusing on navigation, interactive code examples, the try-it panel, and responsive layout behaviors.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will proceed through the primary developer onboarding flow, starting with the home and quickstart pages, then deep-diving into the interactive Charges API try-it panel and adjacent resource pages. It will validate error states, search functionality, and dark mode, before concluding with a focused mobile viewport review to address layout warnings and tap targets.
assumptions: The try-it panel on charges.html is the most complex interactive component and will yield the most significant UX insights.
The search input (ctrl+K) triggers a modal or inline search experience that needs validation.
The dark mode toggle (🌙) applies globally and persists or affects layout/styling across pages.
Horizontal overflow warnings on charges.html, customers.html, and webhooks.html indicate potential responsive design flaws, likely around code blocks or tables.
risk_hotspots: charges.html try-it panel: invalid currency error handling and parameter syncing on scroll
charges.html, customers.html, webhooks.html: horizontal overflow issues on desktop
Global: small tap targets (223x31px) on left navigation links for mobile viewports
Search input: discoverability, interaction, and results navigation

prescan_summary.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https:
headings: Accept your first payment in 5 minutes.

prescan_summary.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url

prescan_summary.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.

observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. observation.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. Recompute the HMAC over "<t>.<body>" using your webhook signing secret and constant-time compare. CURL PYTHON NODE GO import hmac, hashlib, time def verify(payload, header, secret, tolerance=300): ts, sig = [p.split("=")[1] for p in header.split(",")] if abs(time.time() - int(ts)) > tolerance: raise ValueError("expired") expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), f"{ts}.{payload}".encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest() if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, sig): raise ValueError("bad signature") Copy Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler. ON THIS PAGE Event types Verifying signatures Retries

observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url currency_not_supported 400 Currency not enabled on account Enable currency in dashboard amount_too_small 400 Below minimum charge amount Increase amount (min $0.50 USD) amount_too_large 400 Above per-transaction maximum Split the charge missing_required_param 400 Required parameter omitted Check the error param invalid_param 400 Parameter value was invalid See param and message resource_missing 404 No such resource Check the ID resource_already_exists 409 Duplicate idempotency key with different params Use a new idempotency key authentication_required 401 Missing or invalid API key Send Authorization: Bearer sk_… permission_denied 403 API key lacks scope Grant scope in dashboard rate_limited 429 Too many requests Back off; respect Retry-After account_inactive 403 Account is closed or suspended Contact support refund_too_large 400 Refund exceeds refundable amount Check amount_refunded charge_already_captured 400 Charge was already captured No action needed charge_already_refunded 400 Charge fully refunded No action needed customer_max_payment_methods 400 Cannot attach more methods (limit 25) Detach unused methods idempotency_key_in_use 409 Key in use for in-flight request Wait and retry the same key invalid_webhook_signature 400 Webhook HMAC didn't match Check signing secret service_unavailable 503 Temporary outage Retry with backoff; check status page

observation.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO from weave import Weave client = Weave("sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") charge = client.charges.create( amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa", description="UXBench demo charge", ) print(charge.id, charge.status) Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client = Weave(api_key="sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") Copy Idempotency Every state-changing request accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. Pagination List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. has_more tells you when you've reached the end; next_cursor is the opaque token for the next page. Errors WeaveAPI returns conventional HTTP status codes plus a structured error object with type, code, and message. Full list → Popular guides Charges API → Create, capture, list, refund. Customers API → Save methods, manage profiles. Webhooks → Listen for events, sign requests. Error reference → 25+ error codes with hints. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO from weave import Weave client = Weave("sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") charge = client.charges.create( amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa", description="UXBench demo charge", ) print(charge.id, charge.status) Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client = Weave(api_key="sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") Copy Idempotency Every state-changing request accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. Pagination List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. has_more tells you when you've reached the end; next_cursor is the opaque token for the next page. Errors WeaveAPI returns conventional HTTP status codes plus a structured error object with type, code, and message. Full list → Popular guides Charges API → Create, capture, list, refund. Customers API → Save methods, manage profiles. Webhooks → Listen for events, sign requests. Error reference → 25+ error codes with hints. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response.
